title: A restored sign-in that opens reliably
summary: Renew returning sessions once and prevent duplicate startup authorisation from blocking the roster.
changes: Returning users now make one deliberate startup authorisation attempt instead of racing two restored-session callbacks.
An expired saved session is renewed before roster data is requested, and an authentication rejection refreshes once before retrying.
If startup still fails, the opening screen identifies the safe failure stage and code rather than repeating a generic message.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, five-nurse, realtime, privacy, database schema or write rules.
